title: Wrong-Address Track Surcharge: Three-Month Violation Count on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** When a wrong-address violation is booked on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the wrong-address track surcharge counts every violation recorded on the account less than three whole months before the day the wrong-address violation is booked: 5 or more add 2 points; from 3 up to 4 (one fewer than 5) add 1 point; fewer add nothing.

Every violation entry counts, whatever its type — late delivery, missing items, dropped batch, wrong address, conduct complaint, alcohol procedure or any other — so long as it is recorded on the account less than three whole months before the booking day.

## Ladder

| Violations recorded in the three months before booking | Track surcharge |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 2 points |
| 3 or 4 | 1 point |
| 0, 1 or 2 | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Four violations in the last three months (two late deliveries, one dropped batch, one missing-items): 1 point.
- Five violations in the same period: 2 points.
- Two violations in the period and six more from a year ago: only the two count, so nothing.
